operation.label: Map, lines between records: who infected whom, Hagelloch 1861

criteria: The same set of (infector, case) lines; the same count for every outcome; every record counted once
notEstablished: Who infected whom: both sides read the 1861 reconstruction in the infector column.
Where each house stood: both sides read this project's georeference.
That the lines are drawn as computed: this checks the computation the figure is drawn from.
The outcomes Hagelloch does not hold: no case names an unknown case, itself, a duplicated id, or an unplaced house, so those four counts agree at zero only.
